firstPlayerRule: Decide who goes first by rolling the die (and, the rules joke, arguing about the results).
clarifications: When the first player finishes a turn, the player to the left takes a turn, and so on.
The game includes one six-sided die.
interpretation: The rules do not say whether high or low wins the roll; the instruction is deliberately tongue-in-cheek.

SHA-256: 26c797604dc0f28788461e4545cc4ea8a434cde90773719fb5ffd35b1bd8fb65. Read the extracted text of PDF pages 1 and 6. Page 1, Starting and Finishing the Game: decide who goes first by rolling the dice and arguing about the results (a joke sentence), and play then passes to the left. Page 1 also says the game includes 168 cards and one six-sided die. PDF page 6 credits Steve Jackson (design) and John Kovalic (art), with Rules version 1.8 (July 2019), identifying the original Munchkin card game (BGG 1927). Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25. Editorial review 2026-09-25: Rechecked the source pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
uncertainty: No tie-break or high/low convention is given for the roll.
Other Munchkin sets and expansions have their own rulesheets; this record covers the base game.
